Local 27B-class baseline is now measured, not assumed: the shipped system prompt, staged message text, provider wire and parser are sampled against the real served model, and each behaviour must reach a success rate. The measurement changed the product (the reply control had no reachable account; a literal header template made the model echo the header) and the control protocol now passes at 0.85. Retained 2026-10-27 model evidence left both units tentative. The current runner freezes the full typed export, compares the enabled candidate against a control excluding every version of its unit id, and retains configuration, installation, committed-output and original judge request/result coordinates. All current consumer scenarios remain accepted:false; efficacy of this revised path has not been established. K04/K05 remain reference only.
